reviewer.notes: Cross-vendor re-derivation from the raw probe files, not from the harvest UNIT-COMPLETE badge. Probe 1 scanned the live fixture index (reg:fixture-local, 4 entries, 3 unique names) and assigned one verdict per name (all REFUTED for existing-pair collisions; ranked_collision_count=0). Calibration classified hell0-skill and the Cyrillic-o / digit-1 mutants as confusable with hello-skill, and quartz-beacon as not confusable. Probe 2 called the real publish_into path: hell0-skill PUBLISHED at score 90 and entered the index; quartz-beacon PUBLISHED with zero confusable matches. The false-positive mutant injected hello-skill into the control collision set and exited 1. That is the catalog answer: the scan works, and publish does not refuse new confusables.
